Version history
===============

v1.0.0  The first build confirmed working in game.
        Radius 30 sphere, 8,486 blocks placed in 3.6 real seconds, held for 120s of real
        time, restored in 0.45s. Bright blue textures, no title cards.

v1.1.0  Everything after that, all of it requested by the user:
          - abyssal palette: near-black wall (13,14,18), deep teal floor (22,58,64)
          - title cards: the domain name, then its epithet with corner brackets, in blue
          - thrown spells curve towards whatever is trapped inside
          - lock-on auto-targeting, OFF by default (see DomainConfig.AUTO_TARGET_ENABLED)
          - scroll lists the effects with the levels they run at
          - Overflow and Rainfall run one level above the domain, wet amplifiers included
          - mana cost 1000 / 2000 / 3000 instead of 200 / 400 / 600
        Untested in game at the time of tagging: the support spell levels, the scroll text,
        and whether the mana cost is affordable on the user's character.

Rolling back
============

  git clone https://github.com/taccx/mc.git
  cd mc
  git checkout v1.0.0        # or v1.1.0

The jar is NOT byte-reproducible: build.gradle writes an Implementation-Timestamp into the
manifest, so rebuilding the same source produces a jar differing by a byte or two. Compare
behaviour, not hashes, when checking out an older tag and rebuilding.

Installing
==========

Copy the jar into the modpack's mods folder while the game is CLOSED:
  ...\.minecraft\versions\娑熸吉涔嬬瘒路濡傛稛婕箣鎵€瑙乗mods\

Replacing it while the game is loading corrupts the mod scan and crashes the game with a
misleading UnionFileSystem$NoSuchFileException. install-jar.ps1 checks this and refuses.
